disposition_reason: Official control results for 339 milk and dairy samples tested for arsenic and lead in the Republic of Srpska, 2010-2012; every result was below the reporting limit (Table 1).

study.design: Retrospective summary of official food-control testing of milk and dairy products
study.market: domestic and foreign trade, Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
study.method: AAS (Unicam): flame for lead and cadmium, hydride for arsenic, cold vapor for mercury
study.lod_text: not stated separately; results reported as < 0.02 to < 0.1 mg/kg arsenic and < 0.05 mg/kg lead

findings.material_label: Milk and dairy products (pasteurized and sterilized milk, raw milk, cheese, yogurt, sour cream, other dairy incl. chocolate milk, dairy dessert, milk pudding, ice cream, milk powder)
findings.group: official control samples from domestic and foreign trade, Republic of Srpska, June 2010 to March 2012
findings.notes: Pooled across all milk and dairy subgroups; no per-product results. Censored minimum and maximum (all samples below the reporting limit).
